title: Hindi
description: ICSE Class IX Hindi: the Sahitya Sagar short stories and poems, the prescribed novel Naya Raasta (Sarg 1-13), and the composition, letter-writing and unseen-passage language work — all fourteen chapters published.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE ICSE Examination Year 2028 second-language syllabus and Appendix I prescribed books (reproduced CISCE document, Evergreen 'Sahitya Sagar' selections).
syllabusBaselines.note: Prescribed prose selections are registered from the CISCE 2028 appendix. The paper is 80 marks written (Section A language 40, Section B prescribed texts 40) plus 20 marks internal assessment; candidates answer from two prescribed books.

chapters.title: Baat Athanni Ki
chapters.author: Sudarshan
chapters.blurb: A servant borrows half a rupee to repay a friend, and a magistrate who takes a far larger bribe sends him to jail.

chapters.title: Kaaki
chapters.author: Siyaram Sharan Gupta
chapters.blurb: A child who does not understand death tries to fly a kite to heaven so his mother can come back down.

chapters.title: Mahayagya Ka Puraskaar
chapters.author: Yashpal
chapters.blurb: A hungry man gives his only four rotis to a starving dog and discovers that this was his true great sacrifice.

chapters.title: Netaji Ka Chasmaa
chapters.author: Swayam Prakash
chapters.blurb: A lame, mocked-at vendor keeps placing spectacles on Netaji's statue, and children finish his work.

chapters.title: Apna Apna Bhaagya
chapters.author: Jainendra Kumar
chapters.blurb: On a beautiful Nainital night a freezing boy is turned away, and 'each to his own fate' becomes an accusation.

chapters.title: Saakhi
chapters.author: Kabirdas
chapters.blurb: Kabir's couplets on the guru's precedence, the narrow lane of love, and the emptiness of empty ritual.

chapters.title: Girdhar Ki Kundaliyan
chapters.author: Girdhar Kavirai
chapters.blurb: Proverbial couplets on a staff, a blanket, a crow and a boat: prudence, generosity and judging people rightly.

chapters.title: Swarg Bana Sakte Hai
chapters.author: Ramdhari Singh 'Dinkar'
chapters.blurb: Dinkar's argument, voiced as Bhishma's counsel, that heaven is built by human effort here on earth, not won in an afterlife.

chapters.title: Wah Janmabhoomi Meri
chapters.author: Sohanlal Dwivedi
chapters.blurb: A patriotic hymn to the land: the Himalaya kissing the sky, the ocean at its feet, and a country of duty as well as birth.

chapters.title: Megh Aaye
chapters.author: Sarveshwar Dayal Saxena
chapters.blurb: The monsoon as homecoming: clouds arrive dressed as guests and the whole village rises to welcome them.

chapters.title: Naya Raasta (Sarg 1-13)
chapters.blurb: The prescribed novel, read to Sarg 13: family, choice and the search for a new path.

chapters.title: Composition (Rachana)
chapters.blurb: The prescribed composition: a choice of subjects with picture and object prompts, planned and paragraphed.

chapters.title: Letter Writing (Patra Lekhan)
chapters.blurb: Formal and informal letters from a choice of two subjects, with the assessed layout of address, introduction and conclusion.

chapters.title: Unseen Passage (Apathit Gadya)
chapters.blurb: An unseen passage of about 250 words with questions on understanding, answered in Hindi.
